parameters.query:
SELECT g.id AS guest_id, g.party_id, g.status AS guest_status, g.role,
       p.status AS party_status
FROM guests g
JOIN parties p ON p.id = g.party_id
WHERE g.join_token = $1
  AND g.status = 'active'
  AND p.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1

-- Validate claimed quantities do not exceed item totals
SELECT i.id, i.total_quantity,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT SUM(s2.quantity) FROM selections s2
          WHERE s2.item_id = i.id AND s2.guest_id != $1::uuid),
         0
       ) AS others_claimed
FROM items i
WHERE i.party_id = $2::uuid
  AND i.id IN (
    SELECT (elem->>'item_id')::uuid
    FROM json_array_elements($3::json) AS elem
  )

INSERT INTO selections (party_id, guest_id, item_id, quantity)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid,
       (elem->>'item_id')::uuid,
       (elem->>'quantity')::integer
FROM json_array_elements($3::json) AS elem
WHERE (elem->>'quantity')::integer >= 0
ON CONFLICT (guest_id, item_id)
  DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity
RETURNING id, item_id, quantity
